selection: all 158 witnessed base tasks from 32 training material groups; 34 unknown excluded and reported
variants: base only; do not mix unreduced augmented variants
folds: 8 folds, original material group modulo8; no descendant crossing
labels: N and D/lambda_ref from same audited selected witness, fixed balanced score; no minimum claim
acceptance: Existing engineering target N_MAE<=3 and positive D_MAPE<=.25; no gate relaxation; center metrics alone cannot establish interval coverage
scope: Compare label noise/solver-resource convention, not independently measured physical truth; all original published metrics preserved
